html:
La Negrita is a small dark stone statue of the Virgin Mary kept in the Basilica of Our Lady of the Angels in Cartago, Costa Rica. By tradition a mixed-race girl found it on 2 August 1635.

Cartago was founded in 1563 and was the colonial capital until 1823. The story says the statue kept returning to the rock where it was found, so a shrine was built there for the people of mixed descent who lived outside the Spanish town. The Virgin of the Angels became the patron saint of Costa Rica in 1824.

Every August hundreds of thousands walk to Cartago, many the last part on their knees. The present basilica was rebuilt after an earthquake in 1910. Like Our Lady of Guadalupe in Mexico, she joins the Catholic Church to a people who were not its first audience.
sum: La Negrita is a small dark stone statue of the Virgin Mary kept in the Basilica of Our Lady of the Angels in Cartago, Costa Rica. By tradition a mixed-race girl found it on 2 August 1635.
